[COURSEWORK / PROJECT SUMMARY]{.eyebrow}

## The question

What evidence can guide a more useful digital path toward consultation inquiries?

## Approach

Group 6’s Culminating Experience Project covers website/UX, SEO, content, Google Ads, and consumer insights. Han’s contribution focuses on Google Ads measurement and analysis planning.

## What this work demonstrates

San Gabriel is the primary market; Chino Hills is a future planning context. Platform actions require validation before interpretation as qualified inquiries, appointments, or patients. This summary contains no performance figures or private exports.
